evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 800 EUR
Studiengebühren in Höhe von 800 Euro (Bachelor) bzw. 1.200 Euro (Master) pro Semester für Studierende aus Drittstaaten
For the winter semester: 1 April 2027 - 15 July 2027

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page states 800 EUR per semester for applicants from non-EU countries; the THI Studienfinanzierung page states 800 EUR per semester for Bachelor students from Drittstaaten. Intakes: the DAAD page gives 1 April 2027 - 15 July 2027 for the winter semester for applicants from all countries; other THI pages give generic, repeated application windows without a specific year, so they were not used. Application channel: the DAAD page says to submit the application via uni-assist; separate THI pages mention a PRIMUSS applicant portal but do not state it for applicants with a foreign diploma in this international selection procedure. The German-language requirement is only a manual check: German is not required as a minimum level, but a German language certificate A2/B2 may be needed later for internships or work.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate

note.fr: Vérifiez sur le site du programme si un test d'anglais B2 supplémentaire (par ex. Cambridge, PTE, UNIcert) est accepté et si vous êtes exempté.
note.en: Check the programme website whether additional B2 English tests (e.g. Cambridge, PTE, UNIcert) are accepted and whether you are exempt.

note.fr: L'éligibilité à l'admission (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) est décidée après examen de votre dossier ; vous pouvez vérifier vos qualifications sur uni-assist avant de postuler.
note.en: Admission eligibility (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) is decided after reviewing your documents; you can check your qualifications on uni-assist before applying.

evidence.quote: The Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt can only make a legally binding decision about your eligibility for your desired study programme after reviewing the documents you submit with your application.

note.fr: Consultez la page « informations pour les candidats de pays tiers » du programme : un formulaire d'épreuve d'aptitude peut être demandé.
note.en: See the programme's information page for applicants from third countries: an aptitude test form may be required.
